verdict.rationale: Wise publishes extensive public API documentation (account creation, payments, currency receiving, card issuance) and even an llms.txt confirming an AI-discoverable Global Payments API, but no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec could be found (all candidate URLs 404), limiting easy programmatic/agentic integration. Community reports also describe abrupt account-detail changes and account blocks that could disrupt automated API-driven workflows.
